Sustainable Farming 

The Mabaka practice a controlled, non-destructive cyclical system of swidden farming. They cultivate small plots of land with multi-crop varieties (like mountain rice and robusta coffee). Once the soil’s fertility starts to diminish, the plots are entirely left fallow and the land is allowed to naturally regenerate back into a forest, promoting biodiversity and preventing long-term nutrient depletion.
